name: orca
title: Orca Web UI
description: Headless Orca server (AI agent orchestrator) with its web UI.
notes: Builds Orca from the official Linux AppImage and runs its headless web server.

env.name: CONTAINER_NAME
env.label: Container name
env.description: Container name (for docker, unlike 'Name' above which is only used by Portainer to manage displayed stacks)

env.name: UBUNTU_VERSION
env.label: Ubuntu version
env.description: Ubuntu base image version. Orca's headless Linux documentation lists Ubuntu 20.04, 22.04, and 24.04. Ubuntu 24.04 is the newest documented version as of 10/24/2026; Ubuntu 26.04 is not officially listed yet.

env.name: ORCA_PORT
env.label: Web UI port
env.description: Host port for the Orca web UI.

env.name: ORCA_DATA
env.label: Orca data volume
env.description: Host path or Docker volume mounted at /home/orca

env.name: LOCAL_AI_NETWORK
env.label: Network (optional)
env.description: Name of an existing Docker network providing local services (e.g. inference). Leave blank to use Docker's built-in bridge network.
